rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: though ... at sometimes he may thrive

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class

rules.meaning_historical_only: The predicted general long-run effect is failure to accumulate much wealth, though no window or amount is specified.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: as many Significators ... imbecill as strong
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly separately treats a tied count of strong and weak wealth indicators, rather than classifying it as one of the extremes.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class

rules.meaning_historical_only: The equal mixed profile allegedly experiences fluctuating economic outcomes.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: at this time ... increase ... at other times ... impoverish
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly allows alternating gains and losses from different people and commodities within one life.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neither abound with Wealth ... nor ... distress
rules.meaning_historical_only: The equal-strength condition is described as neither enduringly rich nor destitute, with no quantitative threshold.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: in what condition of fortune his Ancestors left him
rules.meaning_historical_only: An explicit social/family-wealth starting baseline is introduced; this must be compared to ordinary inherited socioeconomic status in tests.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: find him in the same condition
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author expects roughly unchanged socioeconomic position in a mixed case; this is a prospective-sounding claim without a measured comparator.

rules.source_label: Majority-weak and tie cases with intermittent gains and baseline class
rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neglect or ill husbandry ... diminishing Patrimony
rules.meaning_historical_only: Poor management of inherited property is allowed as a mechanism of loss, not an astrological test of personal competence.
